preconditions.description: The number of vertices n must be between 2 and 10^6.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(line.split()[1]) <= n for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:])
preconditions.description: All vertex indices must be valid and within the range of 1 to n.

preconditions.expression: all(line.split()[0] in {'AND', 'OR', 'XOR', 'NOT', 'IN'} for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:])
preconditions.description: Each vertex must be of a valid type: AND, OR, XOR, NOT, or IN.

postconditions.description: The output string must have the same length as the number of inputs.

postconditions.expression: all(c in {'0', '1'} for c in stdout)
postconditions.description: The output string must consist only of characters '0' and '1'.
The output string must correctly represent the results of changing each input.
